card.display_name: R39 style tilt / full / a 10/30-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 200-day SMA regime filter
card.thesis: Round 39 tilt cell. Slice: all seven traded names at once -- value, growth, core and the inflation-linked sleeve undivided. One fixed, well-evidenced rule -- a 10/30-day EMA crossover trigger inside a 200-day SMA regime filter, rendered by app.evolution.ruleforms rather than retyped -- applied identically to all 7 name(s) in the slice, with a slot for every name and 0.12 of the book per slot, so 84% of capital is deployed when the rule is fully invested. That is the same budget every card in this field carries, tilt arm and control arm alike, so a cross-slice comparison is a question about style rather than about book size. There is a slot for every name, which means this field has NO slot contention anywhere: no name is ever chosen over another, rank_by is unset on every card because there is nothing to rank, and the ordering artifact PROTOCOL section 7 measures at sigma = 21.2 points cannot operate in this round at all. The only thing separating this card from its own passive control (r39-full-passive) is the timing rule -- same names, same slots, same capital, no stop, no target, no time stop on either arm -- which is what makes tilt-minus-control an attribution to the rule under PROTOCOL section 7's one-decision requirement. The style question is answered by the four passive controls compared against each other; this arm answers only whether the timing rule adds anything on top of the tilt. The programme has never varied the style/factor axis: rounds 17 and 18 varied rule form on sectors, rounds 34-36 varied form, slot cap and fill order on industries and countries, and all of them returned margins inside the 21.2pp ordering-noise floor. This round holds the rule constant and varies the basket's style instead, which is the mirror image of every round before it. The hypothesis is the portfolio expression of a claim taken from this app's own influencer vault (persona wsaj: a ten-year US structural-stagnation view in which post-1982 tailwinds reverse and capital rotates away from mega-cap growth) -- a PROXY for a fundamental claim, not a test of it, because this repository has no fundamentals store and the persona's actual method is P/E and P/B relative valuation, which is unreachable here. No influencer is endorsed and the persona's own stated positioning disagrees with parts of this field. A factor ETF is also a bundle whose construction rules this round does not control: VTV is value because an index provider's screen says so, on a revision schedule invisible in these bars. This card is purpose=roth and every ticker it trades is absent from every savings- and trading-purpose card in the library, because Rev. Rul. 2008-5 destroys rather than defers a wash-sale loss whose replacement is bought inside an IRA. IAU sits in the pinned pool and is traded by nothing here: it is physical gold and the taxable book holds GLD, the textbook substantially-identical pair, and ticker disjointness is necessary but NOT sufficient under IRC section 1091 -- nothing here is a 1091-safety claim. VTI, RSP and SPYG all overlap the S&P 500 the taxable book trades through SPY: economically close, mechanically disjoint, and said out loud rather than left to be noticed. The benchmark is SPY, price-only, in USD, which is the wrong yardstick for a value and mid-cap book measured across a decade of large-cap-growth leadership -- that confound is pre-registered, and it is the entire reason each slice carries its own passive control so the round can report tilt-minus-control rather than tilt-versus-SPY. Not a proposal to trade anything. See strategy-program/ROUND-39-PLAN.md.
card.falsification: Four conditions, fixed before any bar was read. (1) Wrong about the rule if this card's median exposure-adjusted excess over the eight main windows fails to beat r39-full-passive by more than 21.2 percentage points, the programme's measured ordering-noise floor -- a margin inside the floor is a null whichever side of the control it lands on. (2) Wrong about the style if the passive value slice fails to beat the passive growth slice by more than 21.2pp, which is the claim taken from the vault and the one this round exists to test. (3) Beating SPY is NOT the test and failing to beat SPY is NOT the falsification: a value/mid-cap book measured against a US large-cap price index over 2011-2026 inherits a style headwind no rule inside this engine can close, which is the whole reason the control arm exists. (4) The pre-registered failure regime for this slice is chop-2015 and chop-2011. Seven names into seven slots means every whipsaw the crossover suffers is paid seven times over, and both chop windows were cut precisely to expose a crossover that trades constantly and arrives nowhere. If this card's worst window is somewhere else, the mechanism claimed here is not the mechanism operating, and the result needs a different explanation before it needs a promotion -- and nothing is promoted from this round regardless.
card.entry: close > sma(200) and ema(10) crosses_above ema(30)
